gh_1324744245d1055d265b0d16.title: [Hiring] Senior Solidity Smart Contract Engineer | Remote | $12K–$15K/month
gh_1324744245d1055d265b0d16.description:
## Company/Team Overview

**BitAngels** is a US-based blockchain investment group with a long-standing focus on Web3, blockchain infrastructure, and decentralized projects.

We are currently supporting an **Ethereum**-based decentralized governance and staking project and are seeking a Senior Solidity Engineer to join the core protocol development team.

The project already has an MVP and is entering the next phase of product and protocol development. We are looking for an engineer with hands-on production experience who can contribute to technical solutions and architectural decision-making.

**Company Website:** https://bitangels.us/
**Contact Email:** dylan.reed@bitangels.us

## Compensation & Benefits

* **$12,000–$15,000 USD / month**
* Full-time or Part-time options available
* Remote work
* Work directly with the project and engineering teams
* Participate in core protocol design and technical decision-making

## Location

* **Work Location:** Remote; candidates from Mainland China and Hong Kong are welcome
* **Contact Information:**

* Hiring Manager: Dylan Reed
* Email: dylan.reed@bitangels.us
* Telegram: @Web3HiringTalents

## Job Details

* **Employment Type:** Full-time or Part-time
* **Remote Work:** Yes
* **Time Zone Requirement:** Primarily GMT+8; must cover core working hours and adapt to collaboration within a distributed international team
* **Communication Language:** English is the primary language for daily communication (basic professional English proficiency required); technical discussions can be supplemented with written communication. ## Role Requirements & Responsibilities

### Key Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain Ethereum/EVM smart contracts using Solidity
* Lead the development of core protocol features such as Staking and Governance
* Participate in smart contract architecture and technical design
* Conduct code reviews, security audits, and gas optimization
* Write tests and assist with smart contract deployment
* Collaborate with product and engineering teams to drive protocol development and iteration

### Requirements

* Solid experience in Solidity and Ethereum/EVM development
* Proven experience developing and deploying smart contracts in production environments
* Familiarity with DeFi, Staking, Governance, and Token mechanisms
* Understanding of common smart contract security vulnerabilities
* Proficiency with development and testing tools such as Foundry and Hardhat
* Ability to independently own core modules and participate in technical decision-making
* Strong English technical communication skills

**Experience with DAO, Governance, or Staking protocol development, or smart contract security/auditing, is a plus.**

## Work Environment

We are an international, remote-first Web3 team with members distributed across various regions.

This role goes beyond simply building to pre-defined specifications. We look for engineers who can actively participate in protocol design, technical discussions, and early-stage product decision-making, while taking ownership of core smart contracts.

If you are interested in this opportunity, please contact us directly:

**Hiring Manager: Dylan Reed**
**Email: dylan.reed@bitangels.us**
**Telegram: @Web3HiringTalents**

Please include the following when applying:

* CV / Resume
* GitHub profile or relevant projects
* Solidity / Web3 development experience
* Current availability (Full-time / Part-time)

We will first review your background and experience. If there is a preliminary match, we will provide more details about the project and technical direction, and schedule an online call to discuss the role and get to know each other better.

gh_13a4c16d56f29c6c8e1ad75e.title: [Remoto] Administração de Banco de Dados Pleno, 100% Remoto na Sylision
gh_13a4c16d56f29c6c8e1ad75e.description:
## Nossa empresa

A [Sylision](https://sylision.com) é uma plataforma de recrutamento de tecnologia que atua no Brasil e em Portugal. Recrutamos para empresas parceiras e usamos IA para cruzar o seu CV com todas as vagas compatíveis do nosso banco em segundos — você se candidata uma única vez.

## Descrição da vaga

Vaga de Administração de Banco de Dados Pleno, 100% Remoto nível Pleno para atuar em projetos de empresas parceiras da Sylision, na área de Dados.

Faixa salarial: R$ 7.000 a 12.000/mês, conforme experiência.

## Responsabilidades

- Desenvolver e manter serviços de backend
- Modelar dados e integrar sistemas
- Escrever testes e revisar código

## Local

100% remoto, de qualquer lugar do Brasil ou de Portugal.

## Requisitos

**Obrigatórios:**
- Experiência profissional com Administração de Banco de Dados (de 2 a 5 anos)
- Uma linguagem de backend em nível profissional
- APIs REST e SQL
- Git e fluxo de pull request
- Testes automatizados

**Diferenciais:**
- Docker
- Cloud
- Mensageria

## Benefícios

- Faixa salarial de R$ 7.000 a 12.000/mês, publicada aqui e não negociada por último
- Vale-refeição ou vale-alimentação
- Ajuda de custo / auxílio home office para quem atua remoto
- Auxílio mobilidade ou vale-transporte para os dias presenciais
- Plano de saúde e odontológico
- Day off de aniversário e apoio a cursos e certificações
- O pacote final é o da empresa contratante e é confirmado antes de qualquer entrevista

## Contratação

CLT ou PJ, conforme sua preferência e acordo com a empresa contratante.

## Como se candidatar

Candidate-se pela página da vaga: https://www.sylision.com/vagas/desenvolvedor-administracao-de-banco-de-dados-pleno-remoto

Basta enviar o CV uma vez — a IA da Sylision considera seu perfil para esta e para todas as vagas compatíveis, inclusive as que abrirem depois.
